name: openai/gpt-4o-2024-08-06
description: This is the pinned August 6, 2024 snapshot of OpenAI's GPT-4o, accepting text and image input and producing text output. It was the first GPT-4o snapshot to support Structured Outputs, letting developers supply a JSON schema that responses follow, and it raised the output limit over the May 2024 release. Use it for workloads that need a fixed GPT-4o version, especially schema-constrained extraction and function-calling pipelines.
